summary.text: TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS is a private limited company registered in Tau, founded 2020-01-06. TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS rents out storage space, a test area and other service functions to businesses that develop, test and produce autonomous equipment (redskaper). Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 433 980 NOK and the annual result was 23 172 NOK; operating income was down from 1 125 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 746 362 NOK in 2024 to 23 172 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 916 120 NOK in 2024 to 939 292 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Bjørn Aril Veland (styrets leder), with 7 other board members. Its verified website is tauautonomycenter.no, which links to its Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-23 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
